response.justification: Broad, deep engineering background (15+ years) with current Staff-level title and genuine hands-on work in AI-agent infrastructure, MCP code generators, and agentic tooling — which maps directly to the role's AI-native baseline expectation. High-throughput distributed systems experience at Sociomantic/dunnhumby (millions of HTTP requests/sec, async I/O, fibers, caching) is a strong signal, though it is ~6 years old. The main gap is the language profile: the role demands strong Python with working TypeScript, and the resume shows the inverse — TypeScript/Node/DLang depth with no Python mentioned anywhere. Evidence of technical strategy ownership, cross-functional stakeholder management, and on-call/incident response is also thin, reading more as a hands-on senior IC than a domain-level strategy driver. Worth a screen to probe Python depth and scope of influence, but not a clear yes on paper.
strengths: Hands-on agentic AI tooling (MCP generators, agent infrastructure) at current Staff role
Proven high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems work at ad-tech scale
Strong craftsmanship signal: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based dev, OSS test tooling, teaching/talks
concerns: No Python listed despite it being a must-have core language
Little evidence of technical strategy, stakeholder management, or on-call ownership
High-throughput distributed systems experience is dated; recent work is product/full-stack
